reason: The ducks are cute and €29.99 for five pairs undercuts my Happy Socks boxes, but I'd be buying these for Secret Santa and there's no delivery date. They only get made once 100 people reserve, so I could pay €4.99 in October and still have nothing to give in December.
objection: Why pay €4.99 just to reserve something from a brand I've never seen, with no date and no idea how the cotton or the knit holds up next to Stance or Happy Socks?
would_change_my_mind: A guaranteed delivery date before mid-December, with the deposit refunded if the 100 reservations don't come in, plus real close-up photos or reviews of the sock quality.
